name: Greeting Card Display 24 Pockets
description: This greeting card display is a great rack for showing all-occasion or themed greeting cards. This fixture, card display is very popular in retail stores, gift shops and drug stores. This greeting card display has 24 full view pockets, 6 unique pockets located on each of 4 panels. The pockets hold standard 5"w x 7"h greeting cards. This card stand, greeting card display has an additional clip on the top for a message card (supplied by merchant). In addition, this display revolves or spin for easy browsing and loading. This display is made out of steel wire with a black gloss powder coated finish. The rack rests in a strong rounded plastic base. This display is an economical yet efficient way to showcase your greeting cards. This greeting card display comes knocked down. This card display assembles in minutes with no tools necessary! Dimensions: Overall: 20"w x 66"h Base: 20" diameter Pockets Measurements: 5-1/2"w x 4-1/2"h x 1-1/2"d
